step1_figure.circuit_type: Diff-amp with split-tail CMFB and bias circuit
step1_figure.description: A fully-differential NMOS input pair with PMOS current source loads and a split tail current source (M5 biased at Vbiasn and M6t controlled by VCMFB). The circuit is used to characterize the common-mode output voltages as a function of the common-mode feedback voltage VCMFB.

vocm_at_vbiasn.description: Common-mode output voltage when VCMFB equals Vbiasn

equation.explanation: When VCMFB equals the nominal bias voltage Vbiasn, the tail current split is nominally equal and sets the open-loop output common-mode operating point.

sky130_expected.calculation: In textbook 1V design, Vocm is ~700 mV with Vbiasn=400 mV and Vbiasp=600 mV. Scaling to SKY130 (VDD=1.8V, Vthn=0.42V, Vthp=-0.42V), Vbiasn is ~600-700 mV, and with PMOS loads sourcing current near saturation, Vocm sits around 1.1 V to 1.35 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: At nominal tail bias, PMOS load pull-up slightly exceeds NMOS pull-down before feedback closes, biasing Vocm above mid-supply.

vcmfb_target.description: Value of VCMFB required to set the common-mode output to target Vbiasp

equation.explanation: Finds the required common-mode feedback control voltage to balance the output at the PMOS bias level Vbiasp for subsequent stage interfacing.

sky130_expected.calculation: In the textbook, Vbiasn=400 mV and target VCMFB is ~425 mV for Vocm=Vbiasp=600 mV. In SKY130 with Vbiasp ~1.1 V to 1.2 V, VCMFB must increase by 30-80 mV above Vbiasn to pull Vocm down to Vbiasp.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Increasing VCMFB turns on M6t stronger, pulling more tail current and lowering the output common-mode voltage.

vcmfb_offset.description: Offset between target VCMFB and nominal Vbiasn

equation.explanation: Quantifies the systemic offset voltage between the CMFB control voltage and Vbiasn required to balance the diff-amp outputs at the desired target.
equation.assumptions: Ideal transistor matching, offset due to systematic device sizing and branch currents

sky130_expected.calculation: In textbook text: Delta_VCMFB = 425 mV - 400 mV = 25 mV. On SKY130 with overdrive ~150-200 mV, the required shift is ~20 mV to 60 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Systematic offset exists because PMOS loads and split tail NMOS transistors have differing VDS/channel-length modulation operating points.

cmfb_forward_gain.description: Small-signal forward gain from VCMFB to common-mode output voltage

equation.explanation: The forward gain of the common-mode loop through the single tail transistor M6t is halved compared to driving the full tail current.
equation.assumptions: Tail current splits equally between the two input diff-pair branches

sky130_expected.calculation: gm_6t = sqrt(2 * un*Cox * (W/L) * ID) = sqrt(2 * 270u * 10 * 20u) = 0.328 mA/V. Output resistance ro = 1 / ((lambda_n + lambda_p) * ID_branch) = 1 / (0.2 * 20u) = 250 kohm. A_cmfb = -0.5 * gm_6t * ro = -0.5 * 0.328m * 250k = -4.1 V/V (~12.3 dB).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Splitting the tail between fixed bias and CMFB halves the forward gain, aiding CMFB loop compensation and stability.

differential_offset.description: Differential output offset voltage with balanced common-mode inputs

equation.explanation: With perfectly matched layout/devices and identical gate inputs (VCM1 = VCM = 500 mV), differential output voltage should be zero.
equation.assumptions: Perfect device matching in schematic simulation

sky130_expected.calculation: For symmetric netlist without mismatch, v_op - v_om = 0 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Symmetric topology yields zero differential DC output offset.

quiescent_tail_current.description: Total quiescent tail current supplied to the diff-pair

equation.explanation: Sum of currents flowing through the fixed-bias tail NMOS and CMFB-controlled tail NMOS under nominal bias.

sky130_expected.calculation: Each nominal branch is biased at ~20 uA, giving a total tail current of ~40 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Set by the beta-multiplier reference current mirrored through xm5 and xm6t.

step3_testbench.description: Characterization of the diff-amp with split-tail CMFB as in Fig. 26.17, including DC operating point and DC sweep of VCMFB to measure Vocm, CMFB target voltage, offset, and forward gain.
